caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or piece of fabric that is divided into a grid of small, evenly spaced squares, each containing a unique embroidered floral or geometric motif. The fabric is beige or light tan in color and the embroidery threads are primarily shades of blue, with some darker blue and a bit of black for contrast. The motifs are mostly stylized flowers, leaves, and plants, with some squares containing symmetrical designs and others having more intricate, curving patterns. In the upper left quadrant, there is a square with lettering reading “F M D” and “AL 78.” The edges of the fabric are finished with a blue fringe on the right and bottom sides, and the bottom left corner appears to be folded up slightly. The overall composition is orderly, with each square separated by straight stitched lines, creating a clear grid structure across the textile. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, which highlights the colors and details of the textile.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
